parameters.query:
SELECT
  it.id,
  it.created_at,
  it.reviewed_at,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'seldonId', it.source->>'seldonId', it.source->>'seldon id', it.source->>'seldon_id', it.source->>'Seldon ID') AS seldon_id,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'etpId', it.source->>'etpId', it.source->>'etp id', it.source->>'etp_id', it.source->>'ETP ID') AS etp_id,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'purchaseType', it.source->>'purchaseType', it.source->>'purchase_type', it.source->>'Тип закупки', it.card->>'federalLaw') AS purchase_type,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'counterpartyInn', it.card->>'inn', it.source->>'ИНН') AS inn,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'counterpartyName', it.source->>'Контрагент') AS counterparty,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'tenderStatus', it.card->>'status', it.source->>'Статус тендера') AS tender_status,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'tenderStatusReason', it.source->>'Причина статуса') AS tender_status_reason,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'op', it.source->>'ОП') AS op,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'legalEntity', it.card->>'etmLegalEntity', it.source->>'Юридическое лицо ЭТМ') AS etm_legal_entity,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'initialPrice', it.source->>'Начальная цена') AS initial_price,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'finalPrice', it.source->>'Конечная цена') AS final_price,
  btrim(concat_ws(' ', NULLIF(it.card->>'submissionDeadlineDate', ''), NULLIF(it.card->>'submissionDeadlineTime', ''))) AS submission_deadline,
  COALESCE(it.card->>'tenderUrl', it.card->>'tenderUrlSource', it.source->>'Ссылка на тендер', it.source->>'tender_url') AS tender_url,
  it.discrepancy_notes,
  CASE WHEN it.reviewed_at IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS reviewed
FROM imported_tenders it
ORDER BY it.created_at DESC, it.id DESC
LIMIT 5000;
